meta.name: archimate
meta.description: Create ArchiMate enterprise architecture diagrams using PlantUML stdlib macros. Best for TOGAF viewpoints, layered EA modeling (Business/Application/Technology), motivation analysis, and migration planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 PlantUML 绘制企业架构图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需用 ArchiMate 标准绘制企业架构视图
copy.tagline_en: Create enterprise architecture diagrams with PlantUML
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create ArchiMate enterprise architecture views

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成 ArchiMate 企业架构图，包括业务、应用、技术等分层视图，并自动使用 PlantUML 代码绘制。
howto.when: 当你要求绘制企业架构图、TOGAF 视图或分层 EA 模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个业务层和应用层的架构图。
say.note: Claude 会生成 PlantUML 代码并渲染图表。

say.text: 用 ArchiMate 画一个客户下单的流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate ArchiMate enterprise architecture diagrams based on your description, including layered views (Business/Application/Technology), using PlantUML code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create enterprise architecture diagrams, TOGAF viewpoints, or layered EA models.

say_en.text: Draw a business and application layer architecture diagram.
say_en.note: Claude will generate PlantUML code and render the diagram.

say_en.text: Draw a customer ordering process using ArchiMate.
say_en.note: Claude will use Business_Process and other elements.
